Hi Marissa,

Thanks for making time last week. Our procurement and infosec teams are reviewing Redwood for an upcoming production rollout and they asked for two quick items before we can progress the security gate: a copy of your most recent SOC 2 Type II report and clarification on the audit coverage window.

During an internal review we flagged an auditor note referencing a retention exception that we believe occurred around mid-October 2025. To help our internal risk committee we need:
- The official SOC 2 Type II report (covering the audited period).
- A short management response that acknowledges the finding and explains the remediation timeline (or points to a bridge letter if auditors have issued one).
- If you have an interim remediation memo or evidence showing corrective actions taken after the audit period, please include that as well.

Our target deadline is COB 2026-11-30 so we can present to the committee on Dec 2. If you prefer, we can schedule a 20–30 minute call to walk through the materials.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Marissa / team — quick technical summary and draft memo points (will produce the PDF attachments once you confirm):

Summary of issue:
- Root cause: a data retention policy transition during an internal storage migration (cutover on 2025-10-20) temporarily bypassed an automated retention enforcement rule for a subset of backup manifests. That resulted in a retention gap for records created 2025-10-20 through 2025-10-22.
- Audit coverage window (per our auditor): 2025-04-01 to 2025-10-31 (SOC 2 Type II period). The retention gap falls inside the audit window.

Remediation timeline (completed / in-place):
- 2025-11-01: retention enforcement automation rolled out to all clusters (prevents recurrence).
- 2025-11-10: bulk backfill job initiated to recreate retention flags for affected manifests.
- 2025-11-18: backfill completed; verification audit run and logs archived.

Evidence available (suggest redacted exports to share):
- backup_manifests_2025-10-20_to_2025-10-22.log (hash: a3f4...)
- retention_enforcement_deploy_2025-11-01.txt
- backfill_run_2025-11-10-2025-11-18.csv

I'll assemble a 1-page Interim_Remediation_Memo.pdf that covers the above with dates and verification checks.

Rishi
Senior Staff Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
